problem_restatement: Determine whether BRENTOIL canary data supports transferring the retired Range Onset mechanism to BRENTOIL or adding the asset to a successor live roster.

known_facts.range_onset_canary_attribution: No reconciled BRENTOIL lifecycle used Range Onset. The three BRENTOIL canary lifecycles used HIP-3 Swing/HA or HIP-3 Breakout Pressure.

descriptive_live_lifecycles.interpretation: Mixed-profile execution evidence only; two exits were operator overrides and the largest winner determines the positive aggregate.

analysis: The canary proves that BRENTOIL can be observed and executed with usable liquidity, but it does not validate Range Onset or either retired HIP-3 route. The distinct five-minute oil-shock hypothesis becomes negative under canary-derived stress friction and has not produced a prospective entry. Liquidity is necessary but not evidence of positive strategy expectancy.

decision.reason: Range Onset has no BRENTOIL canary attribution, and the distinct five-minute oil-shock candidate fails stress and remains technically unresolved.

reopen_condition: Only a newly versioned, preregistered BRENTOIL mechanism may reopen asset candidacy after exact venue friction, resolved mark/L2 paths, both-side chronological evidence, positive stress economics, and positive economics after removing the largest winner. Do not transfer or retune Range Onset for BRENTOIL.

success_criteria: No live or successor configuration maps Range Onset to BRENTOIL
The active hypothesis ledger retains this rejection
BRENTOIL remains report-only until a distinct mechanism satisfies the reopen condition
falsifiers: A reconciled historical BRENTOIL lifecycle is found with exact Range Onset identity
The referenced lifecycle or development artifacts fail checksum or arithmetic reconciliation
A separately preregistered distinct mechanism satisfies every reopen condition

confidence.basis: Exact BRENTOIL lifecycle attribution, source-bound five-minute development evidence, and current prospective observer status agree on non-promotion.
confidence.limitations: The evidence does not prove BRENTOIL is permanently untradable; it rejects this transfer and the currently tested mechanism under the frozen contracts.
